title: The Boilermaker Trade, Learning Path, Rights and Responsibilities
objective: Understand the Boilermaker trade, the occupational learning pathway and the learner's responsibilities.
safety_boundary: Orientation and knowledge only. This lesson does not authorise practical trade work.

sections.heading: 1. The trade
sections.body: Boilermakers fabricate, assemble, maintain and repair metal components and structures within controlled workplace requirements.

sections.heading: 2. The learning journey
sections.body: The qualification combines knowledge learning, practical skills and workplace experience. Each part has a different purpose.

sections.heading: 3. Controlled information
sections.body: Drawings, specifications, procedures and authorised instructions help define what work is required and how quality is controlled.

sections.heading: 4. Rights and responsibilities
sections.body: Learners have a responsibility to learn safely, ask when unsure, protect others and follow authorised workplace requirements.
